Serialization support has been implemented for [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_ndvn4oj/s2/shapeindex.go#L584) along with all built-in shape types.

### Summary of Changes

1. **[`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_ndvn4oj/s2/shapeindex.go) Serialization:**
   - Added `Encode(w io.Writer) error`: Flushes pending updates and serializes index configuration (`maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`), shapes with their IDs and type tags, and full spatial cells (`CellID`, clipped shapes, center containment, edge IDs).
   - Added `Decode(r io.Reader) error`: Restores `shapes` mapped to their original shape IDs and reconstructs `cells` and `cellMap` so queries and iterators operate immediately without calling `Build()`.
   - Guaranteed non-empty byte stream encoding even for an empty `ShapeIndex`.

2. **Built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_ndvn4oj/s2/shape.go#L184) Support:**
   - Extended type tags in [`typeTag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_ndvn4oj/s2/shape.go#L142) to include `typeTagLoop` (6) and `typeTagLaxLoop` (7).
   - Added `Encode(io.Writer) error` and `Decode(io.Reader) error` to [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_ndvn4oj/s2/point_vector.go#L29), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_ndvn4oj/s2/lax_polyline.go#L27), [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_ndvn4oj/s2/lax_polygon.go#L65), and [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_ndvn4oj/s2/lax_loop.go#L28).
   - Ensured zero-edge geometries (e.g., empty/1-vertex loops, empty polylines, 0-vertex lax loops/polygons, full polygons/loops) and mixed chain counts round-trip accurately.

3. **Malformed & Adversarial Input Robustness:**
   - Implemented bounds checks against maximum thresholds (`maxEncodedShapes`, `maxEncodedCells`, `maxEncodedEdgesPerCell`, `maxEncodedVertices`).
   - Slices and maps are allocated with incremental capacity bounds (`min(n, 1024)`) during decoding to prevent OOM panics on oversized allocation requests with truncated streams.
   - Strict validation for cell monotonicity, valid `CellID`s, edge ID ranges, and existing shape ID references.

4. **Testing & Branching:**
   - Added tests in [`s2/shapeindex_encode_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_ndvn4oj/s2/shapeindex_encode_test.go) covering empty indices, all built-in shape types, shape ID preservation across removals, zero-edge shapes, mixed chain counts, spatial queries without `Build`, truncated prefixes, corrupted data, oversized allocations, and fuzz testing.
   - All work is committed to the new branch `shapeindex-serialization` off `main`.
